prompt: Create an edge-to-edge 1440×1000 desktop web homepage comp for Glewstudio, a streaming learning library for people learning studio and commercial photography. The visitor's job is to find a course and start watching. Lead with the featured course “Iluminación Cinematográfica: Del Concepto al Resultado” and its concise description: “Aprende a diseñar esquemas de iluminación complejos para retratos, moda y fotografía comercial con Carlos Mendoza.” Include clearly legible Spanish controls “Reproducir”, “Más información”, and “Mi Lista” with a plus icon. Below the cinematic hero, show the first portions of horizontal content rows titled “Tendencias”, “Iluminación Pro”, and “Recientes”, using existing course titles such as “Iluminación Rembrandt para Retrato”, “Retoque de Piel en Photoshop CC”, “Fotografía de Producto en Mesa de Luz”, “Color Grading Cinematográfico”, and “Softboxes, Paraguas y Modificadores”. Do not show ratings, student counts, testimonials, or invented statistics. Membership plans belong further down, not in the lead viewport. Keep Glewstudio's existing name and mark, Manrope typography, OLED background #0A0A0F, and restrained warm-gold #E8B86D accent. Structure: a wide image-led hero with its content aligned left and a dark fade that joins the rows beneath. Buttons use translucent dark glass. Compose a complete working-product screen, not a poster, photograph with text, or marketing splash. Crisp readable UI-sized text, real card thumbnails, full screen to all edges, no browser frame or device.
